title: 第10章 大壮~~我还想要~~
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
林晚禾娇羞中带着急切的声音，让李大壮回过了神来，他清了清嗓子：“别急，这就来！”

    话音刚落，李大壮就开始帮林晚禾按摩治疗了。

    陌生而奇妙的触感，让俩人都是一愣！

    尤其是林晚禾，李大壮的手有种烫人的温度，还带着一些磨人的茧子，粗糙却刺激，才治了一下，就让林晚禾忍不住娇叫出声：“哦~~好~~好刺激~~~”

    “林医生，忍着点，让人听见还以为我怎么你了呢。”李大壮故意逗弄。

    林晚禾果然吓得捂住了嘴巴，可随着李大壮的按摩的越来越到位，越来越有力，她实在忍不住了，只能从指缝里娇哼低吟。

    其实李大壮也不好受……

    幸好这种既美妙，又磨人的滋味并没有持续太久，李大壮就收了手。

    “该针灸了！”

    “啊~不按了？可我还想要啊~~”林晚禾就像是欲求不满的少妇，美眸里散发着渴望的光。

    “林医生，我有自己的治疗节奏，你最好不要随意打乱。”李大壮说的一本正经，其实他也都快炸了，只是治疗床遮挡着，没暴露而已。

    林晚禾却信以为真，顿时为自己的行为臊的满脸通红，连忙娇喘着道歉：“对~对不起啊，我~我也不知道怎么回事，平时我不这样的！”

    “理解，我的按摩手法比较特殊，混合了我自身的气息，会让人感觉特别舒服，你会还想要，也是正常。”李大壮很善解人意的解释。

    林晚禾松了口气，只要大壮医生别嫌弃自己不自重就行。

    不知不觉间，林晚禾已经很在意这个才第一次见面的男人，对自己的看法了！

    李大壮不知道林晚禾的那些女人心思，而是手指翻飞，将真气汇聚在银针上，扎进林晚禾患处周围的穴位上！

    林晚禾本能的瑟缩了一下，可预料中的疼痛并没有出现，反而是和按摩有异曲同工之妙的舒爽，银针落肉之处，仿佛有丝丝细流，涌入肌肤，又在患处底部汇聚，最后猛的冲向患处的顶端，并且逐渐向周围蔓延！

    “哦……好麻……好舒服……”
content_en:
"Ugh!"

    Li Dazhuang was knocked all over, and he felt a soft fragrance coming over him. When he lowered his head, he saw a dazzling white snow. The soft touch rubbed against his upper body through the thin short-sleeved top, making his mouth dry and his eyes almost burning!

    "Doctor Lin! I'm happy to be happy, but it's not good to take advantage of me, right?"

    Li Dazhuang's low and hoarse voice brought Lin Wanhe back to his senses in an instant. Only then did he realize how inappropriate his posture was. He quickly withdrew from Li Dazhuang's arms and covered his turbulent upper body.

    But after all, my hands were small and the spray was big, so I could only cover it up and see, but there was still a lot of white snow peeking out from between Lin Wanhe’s fingers!

    This half-covered and half-exposed scenery is the most alluring, and Li Dazhuang was stunned!

    Only then did Lin Wanhe realize that this guy had just said that he had taken advantage of him, but that was the opposite. It was clearly him who had taken advantage of him!

    "Well, you should get dressed first, I have to go."

    If he didn't leave, Li Dazhuang was afraid that he would have a nosebleed.

    "I'll go to your village to get a massage from you tomorrow!" Lin Wanhe shouted excitedly.

    Li Dazhuang had already gone far. When he returned to the clinic where his parents were, he saw that Zhang Zhensheng had treated his family as guests. He was serving tea and drinking water, laughing and chatting with him. Where could he still look like when he was mocking him before?

    "Hey! Divine Doctor Li is back! Please sit down quickly and I'll pour you some tea!" As soon as Zhang Zhensheng saw Li Dazhuang, he immediately went to greet him. Even if he didn't become a disciple, he tried his best to please him and even called the miracle doctor.

    "No need, since everything has been resolved, we will go back first." Li Dazhuang's tone was calm, which actually showed his momentum.

    Zhang Zhensheng was very respectful and sent his family all the way outside the health center.

    At this time, a red BMW drove towards this direction quickly, and finally stopped suddenly in front of everyone. The driver's door opened, and a beautiful and sexy woman wearing black stilettos, black stockings, and a red one-piece hip-hugging skirt stepped out of the car with an anxious look on her face.
